description: Public read API for the Awtsmoos Torah library: 21,000+ Torah posts (Tanach, Mishnah, Talmud Bavli, Yerushalmi, Rambam, Midrash, Chassidus) with Hebrew+English translations, exact Hebrew search, semantic vector search, reverse citation index, and friendly URLs.

endpoints.name: readPostById

params.key: postId (bare ID works via suffix match)

endpoints.returns: Post record: { postId, heichelId, seriesId, title, unitCount, units: [{ ref, hebrew, english, phrases: [{hebrew, english}] }] }

endpoints.name: readPostInSeries
endpoints.returns: Post record in series context (Hebrew + English units)

endpoints.name: listSeries
endpoints.returns: Detailed series list: titles, structure, counts

endpoints.name: seriesContents

params.details: optional true -> full metadata instead of post listing

endpoints.returns: Posts of the series, or full series metadata with ?details=true

endpoints.name: listPostsInSeries
endpoints.returns: Post listing; /posts/details for the expanded form

endpoints.name: exactHebrewSearch
endpoints.returns: Word-exact matches from prebuilt packed indexes

endpoints.name: exactSearchMeta
endpoints.returns: Prebuilt corpora, excluded series families, worker status

endpoints.name: semanticSearch
endpoints.returns: Meaning-ranked results from verified translated content (multilingual-e5-small, 384 dims)

endpoints.name: librarySearch
endpoints.returns: Blended lexical + semantic results (the site's own public search)

endpoints.name: searchCapabilities
endpoints.returns: Live engine capabilities: modes, semantic model, indexed lanes, exact corpora

endpoints.name: connectionsByPost
endpoints.returns: Citation graph for the post: what it cites + what cites it

endpoints.name: connectionsByRef
endpoints.returns: Reverse index: every post that references this citation key

forAgents.auth: none — every read endpoint is an unauthenticated GET
routingRules: Known citation -> friendly URL (see friendlyUrls), else post ID -> GET /api/social/packed/read?key=

limits.auth: none for all GET reads; import/write lanes are Ed25519-signed (operator-only)
limits.guidance: page with offset/limit; cache immutable post content; set a descriptive User-Agent

name: Awtsmoos API
